footer.privacyText: Reelcraft stores only the account details you provide and the clips you save. Demo scripts stay in your browser and are never sent to a server. You can delete your account and clips at any time.
footer.termsText: Reelcraft is provided as is for video generation. You own the clips you create from your scripts. Final pricing, limits and availability are confirmed on the pricing page before you pay.
